shellCommands.command: git status --short; git branch -a; cat package.json; ls; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; git diff; git log --oneline | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

git checkout -b cache-components; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "hours" -A6 node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rln "force-dynamic" . | head; grep -rn -i "opt out\|opt-out\|unstable_instant\|instant = " 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache* 01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls 01-app/02-guides | grep -i cache
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =\|revalidate =" app
